coverage.assertion: Seeded category counts, relation integrity, history and query oracles pass before timing.
Run admitted reduced/full scales with detailed properties, ports, systems and parametric records.
Measure bulk readiness, isolated operations, aged mixed traffic, contention and working sets.
Report failures, latency distributions, achieved/offered load, resource peaks and capacity limits.
State that database-only synthetic results do not qualify geometry or a real hospital inventory.

limitations: Ten reduced admissions are one comparison, not ten full-capacity qualifications.
Job durations have one-second timestamp granularity; raw loader phases and cgroup CPU retain finer measurements.
Host services and filesystem caches remained active; no database/language architecture winner is selected.
Aggregate allocation was checked before every sample and reserves during loader checkpoints; the full trial has a separate continuous watchdog.
The new full-reference plan and COPY literal-span changes are later source c0ad967, outside this prepared76 comparison.
No full history, branch/client sweep, paced offered load, rendering or engineering qualification is established.
decisionImplications: The prepared path preserves the tested source/body contract and reduces measured client CPU at reduced scale.
Use the separately validated final source and a fresh full run to evaluate actual full admission; do not extrapolate reduced throughput.
